description: Root-cause classes (one vocabulary for retros, the aggregator and the gate). ordering: steps done in the wrong order; process: push, gate or commit discipline; brief: missing or ambiguous brief; env: shell, toolchain or machine; drift: generated or catalogued data out of sync; boundary: ports, ownership, manifests; check-gap: a check existed but ran too late or not at all; api-misuse: an assumed API, id or signature; test-fragility: a test pinned a value or fixture; single-writer: two writers of one artifact.
